# KGM1B cross-language conformance vectors (#257).
#
# Consumed by all three implementations so a format change cannot pass in one
# language while silently diverging in another:
#   - JS     tests/run-tests.mjs
#   - Python packages/kgm1-codec-py (via `python3 -m kgm1_codec verify-vectors`)
#   - Rust   crates/kgm1-codec (tests::matches_shared_conformance_vectors)
#
# The Rust crate has no dependencies, not even dev ones, which is worth keeping
# for a protocol codec that may be vendored or audited. So this is a pipe-
# delimited text file rather than JSON: every language parses it with a split
# and no library.
#
# Columns:
#   kind|name|packetHex|versionMajor|versionMinor|frameId|sourceTimeNs|
#   monotonicTimeNs|flags|encoding|payloadType|payloadLen|payloadHex
#
# kind=roundtrip  encoding the fields MUST produce packetHex, and decoding
#                 packetHex MUST reproduce the fields and payload.
# kind=reject     decoding packetHex MUST fail. Field columns are "-".
#
# A "-" payloadHex means an empty payload.

roundtrip|empty-payload|4b474d31010000000100000000000000020000000000000003000000000000000000000000000000|1|0|1|2|3|0|0|0|0|-
